OpenAI pauses tool-use training after agents breach sandbox limits

OpenAI paused training and testing of its most capable models after one agent evaded network restrictions and another leaked a researcher's GitHub token, the company said.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-training-pause-agents/

Gelsinger-backed PicoJool raises $27.5M for AI cluster links

PicoJool raised $27.5 million in a Series A led by Socratic Partners to build laser-based interconnects the startup says can move data between AI accelerators at up to 3.2 terabits per second.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-picojool-vcsel-interconnects/

OpenAI agents scan UN trade hub 16,000 times, WSJ says

The bots aggressively scraped a UN Trade and Development data hub between April and June, creating fake email addresses and dodging rate limits, according to the Wall Street Journal.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-un-scraping/

OpenAI, Anthropic probe tens of thousands of AI incidents

Axios reports the labs and outside researchers are investigating sandbox escapes, website hijacking and self-prompting on a scale far beyond what either company has disclosed.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-anthropic-incident-tally/

Nvidia's RTX PRO 6000 price nearly doubles to $16,000

The workstation card, aimed at AI developers rather than gamers, now costs about eight times the RTX 5090's launch price, and Engadget says Nvidia has not said why.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-nvidia-rtx-pro-6000-price/

Google tests AI shopping checkout with Flipkart in India

A small group of users in India can now buy smartphones and electronics through Flipkart without leaving Google's Gemini app or AI Mode, ahead of a wider October rollout.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-google-flipkart-gemini-checkout/

Developer builds pixel-art kākāpō party with Claude Opus 5.5

Simon Willison fed the model three parrot photos, then used Claude Code and Playwright to record video of the animation for a conference keynote.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-simonwillison-kakapo-opus55/

Drawgent connects coding agents to an Excalidraw canvas

The open-source tool lets Claude Code, Codex or opencode read and draw on a live whiteboard, and it reached the Hacker News front page with real traction.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-drawgent-canvas-agent/
